technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with RSI14 and MACD bullish but undermined by price below key moving averages, weak trend strength (ADX 18), and bearish Ichimoku cloud positioning.

fundamental.summary: INVH shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 14 days with no fundamental catalysts evident.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (32/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral overall setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (358.6), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, CPI event imminent, and earnings binary in 14 days create compounded downside risk for real estate sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI14, MACD, and Supertrend are bullish with price near support (29.96) in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis), offering contrarian entry for mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price is below all key moving averages (EMA9/21, SMA50/200, VWAP), ADX is weak (18.12), earnings binary in 14 days, macro headwinds severe (VIX 358.6, rising yields, strong dollar), and zero fundamental/insider conviction make this a high-risk trap.

decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary in 14 days combined with macro crisis (VIX 358.6, rising yields, strong dollar) creates compounded downside risk; price below all moving averages suggests structural weakness despite momentum signals.
